notes: 手动策展目录。价格会变动，卡片不再手标死价格（Amazon 政策禁止手标价格），只给 'View Deal' 按钮 + 'verify on store' 提示。storeUrl 用各平台搜索链接，避免猜错 ASIN/商品 slug。network 取值：amazon / gmg / humble / fanatical。tags 用于栏目页过滤：popular=常青热门, longtail=长尾/稍冷门, new-release=2024-2026 近期或即将发售, weekly=本周精选策展。

deals.title: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe
deals.note: Nintendo first-party rarely dips below MSRP. Best discounts show up in eShop seasonal sales and bundle offers.

deals.title: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom
deals.note: A 2023 GOTY contender. Digital editions occasionally drop during Nintendo eShop holiday sales.

deals.title: Super Mario Bros. Wonder
deals.note: The definitive 2D Mario. Full price most of the year; watch for holiday and Black Friday dips.

deals.title: Animal Crossing: New Horizons
deals.note: The cozy-life sim evergreen. Often bundled with consoles; standalone dips appear in big seasonal sales.

deals.title: Super Mario Odyssey
deals.note: Still the best 3D Mario. Frequently discounted in Nintendo's budget 'Selects' range.

deals.title: Pokémon Scarlet & Violet
deals.note: The open-world Pokémon duo. Dual-pack and eShop sales appear a few times a year.

deals.title: Mario Kart World
deals.note: The Switch 2 launch racer. New entry, so expect list price; bundle-with-console deals are the first to appear.

deals.title: Donkey Kong Bananza
deals.note: A fresh 3D platformer exclusive to Switch 2. New release — watch for holiday bundles later in the year.

deals.title: Metroid Prime 4: Beyond
deals.note: The long-awaited return of Samus. Pre-orders and launch-week stock are the first buying windows.

deals.title: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
deals.note: The open-world classic. Continuously discounted in Nintendo Selects; a safe cheap pickup.

deals.title: Luigi's Mansion 3
deals.note: Charming solo/co-op haunted-house action. GMG digital keys often sit below Nintendo eShop pricing.

deals.title: Super Smash Bros. Ultimate
deals.note: The ultimate party fighter. Staple gift title; dips show up every major sale period.

deals.title: Splatoon 3
deals.note: Nintendo's ink-splatting shooter. Digital keys through GMG routinely beat eShop direct.

deals.title: Kirby and the Forgotten Land
deals.note: The pink puffball's first 3D adventure. Quietly discounted several times a year.

deals.title: Pikmin 4
deals.note: Accessible strategy-adventure. GMG keys typically undercut the eShop list price.

deals.title: Xenoblade Chronicles 3
deals.note: A massive JRPG. Long RPGs like this see steady digital-key discounts on GMG.

deals.title: Bayonetta 3
deals.note: PlatinumGames' stylish action title. Niche but frequently price-cut on key stores.

deals.title: Fire Emblem Engage
deals.note: Tactical RPG with a loyal fanbase. Discounts appear a few months after release.

deals.title: Mario Party Superstars
deals.note: The go-to local multiplayer party game. Bundle and holiday dips are common.

deals.title: Pokémon Legends: Arceus
deals.note: The open-world Pokémon prequel. Well past launch — steady Selects-range pricing.

deals.title: Hyrule Warriors: Age of Calamity
deals.note: Musou-style Zelda spin-off. GMG keys usually cheaper than eShop direct.

deals.title: Nintendo Switch Sports
deals.note: Family-friendly motion sports. Often bundled with the Switch Lite or OLED.

deals.title: Ring Fit Adventure
deals.note: Fitness-RPG hybrid. Supply-driven pricing; watch for restocks and sale events.

deals.title: Mario + Rabbids Sparks of Hope
deals.note: Turn-based tactical spin on Mario. Deeply discounted on key stores post-launch.

deals.title: Marvel's Spider-Man 2
deals.note: PS5 console exclusive. GMG key sometimes beats PS Store credit pricing.

deals.title: God of War Ragnarök
deals.note: The Norse saga finale. A perennial best-seller that dips during PlayStation sales.

deals.title: Horizon Forbidden West
deals.note: Guerrilla's open-world sequel. PSN digital codes on GMG undercut the store.

deals.title: The Last of Us Part II Remastered
deals.note: The remastered PS5 edition. Steady discounts track the HBO show's seasons.

deals.title: Ghost of Tsushima
deals.note: Sucker Punch's samurai epic. Director's Cut on PS5 sees regular key-store cuts.

deals.title: Demon's Souls
deals.note: Bluepoint's gorgeous PS5 remake. Launched at $69.99; key stores undercut over time.

deals.title: Ratchet & Clank: Rift Apart
deals.note: The dimension-hopping showcase platformer. Frequent GMG price drops.

deals.title: Returnal
deals.note: Housemarque's roguelike shooter. Deep cuts appear well after launch.

deals.title: Final Fantasy VII Rebirth
deals.note: The middle chapter of the FFVII remake. New release — first real discounts land months in.

deals.title: Final Fantasy XVI
deals.note: Square's action-Fantasy epic. Steady key-store discounts post-launch.

deals.title: Marvel's Spider-Man: Miles Morales
deals.note: The shorter standalone Spidey entry. Often bundled with the full sequel.

deals.title: Gran Turismo 7
deals.note: Polyphony's racing sim. Steady discounts; a good pick for racing fans.

deals.title: Astro Bot
deals.note: The critically adored 2024 platformer. New release — first price cuts land later in the year.

deals.title: Rise of the Ronin
deals.note: Team Ninja's open-world action RPG. 2024 release with deepening key-store discounts.

deals.title: Helldivers 2
deals.note: The surprise 2024 co-op hit. Demand-driven pricing; key stores occasionally undercut.

deals.title: Stellar Blade
deals.note: Shift Up's stylish action game. 2024 release; first real cuts appear months in.

deals.title: Black Myth: Wukong
deals.note: The 2024 action blockbuster. High demand keeps pricing firm; watch for seasonal drops.

deals.title: Silent Hill 2 Remake
deals.note: Bloober's acclaimed survival-horror remake. 2024 release; cuts follow after the buzz.

deals.title: Forza Horizon 5
deals.note: The墨西哥 open-world racer. Xbox digital codes on GMG routinely beat the MS Store.

deals.title: Halo Infinite
deals.note: 343's flagship shooter. Campaign + multiplayer; deep key-store discounts.

deals.title: Gears 5
deals.note: The cover-shooter revival. Long on the market; steady heavy cuts.

deals.title: Microsoft Flight Simulator
deals.note: The realistic flight sim. Premium Deluxe add-ons sell separately; base dips often.

deals.title: Starfield
deals.note: Bethesda's space RPG. 2023 launch; key stores now sit well below launch price.

deals.title: Indiana Jones and the Great Circle
deals.note: MachineGames' 2024 adventure. New release — first discounts appear months after launch.

deals.title: Sea of Thieves
deals.note: Rare's shared-world pirate sim. Now on more platforms; frequent key-store cuts.

deals.title: Hi-Fi Rush
deals.note: Tango's rhythm-action gem. Quietly discounted; a cheap, cheerful pickup.

deals.title: Call of Duty: Black Ops 6
deals.note: GMG digital keys usually undercut console disc prices and work across Xbox, PS, and PC.

deals.title: EA Sports FC 25
deals.note: Humble's digital store runs frequent promos; previous FC entries hit half-price within months.

deals.title: Hogwarts Legacy

deals.title: Elden Ring

deals.title: Baldur's Gate 3

deals.title: Red Dead Redemption 2
deals.note: Rockstar's western masterpiece. Six years on, it sits at its lowest-ever key price.

deals.title: Cyberpunk 2077
deals.note: The 'Ultimate Edition' bundles the acclaimed Phantom Liberty. Deep, steady discounts.

deals.title: Monster Hunter Wilds
deals.note: Capcom's 2025 hunting epic. New release — first real cuts appear ahead of seasonal events.

deals.title: Assassin's Creed Shadows
deals.note: Ubisoft's feudal-Japan entry. 2025 release; key stores undercut the Ubisoft Store.

deals.title: Kingdom Come: Deliverance II
deals.note: Warhorse's 2025 medieval RPG. New release — first discounts land a few months in.

deals.title: Grand Theft Auto VI
deals.note: The most-anticipated release of the cycle. Pre-orders at list price; the first real deals follow launch.

deals.title: Star Wars Outlaws
deals.note: Ubisoft's open-world Star Wars game. 2024 release with deepening key-store discounts.

deals.title: Avatar: Frontiers of Pandora
deals.note: Massive's open-world Avatar. Heavily discounted post-launch on key stores.

deals.title: Dying Light 2
